questions.audio_text: A: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the National Museum? B: Sure. Go straight ahead for two blocks, then turn left at the traffic lights. The museum is on your right, opposite the central park. A: Is it far from here? B: No, it is only about a ten-minute walk.
questions.explain: Câu 1: đi thẳng 2 dãy nhà rồi rẽ trái ở đèn giao thông. Câu 2: bảo tàng đối diện công viên trung tâm ('opposite the central park').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

options: A. Turn right at the traffic lights
B. Turn left at the traffic lights
C. Turn left at the second corner
D. Go straight for three blocks
sub_questions.q: What should the man do at the traffic lights?

options: A. Next to the central park
sub_questions.q: Where is the museum?

questions.audio_text: Attention, passengers! This is an announcement for flight VN123 to Singapore. Due to bad weather, the flight will be delayed by one hour. The new departure time is 3:30 p.m. Passengers are requested to stay in the departure lounge. We apologise for any inconvenience.
questions.explain: Câu 1: chuyến bay bị hoãn 1 giờ ('delayed by one hour'). Câu 2: giờ khởi hành mới là 3:30 chiều.
questions.q: Nghe thông báo và trả lời câu hỏi

options: B. It is delayed by one hour
C. It is delayed by two hours
sub_questions.q: What happens to flight VN123?
What is the new departure time?

questions.audio_text: A: Have you decided what to study at university, Mai? B: Yes, I want to study environmental science. I am worried about pollution in our city. A: That is a great choice! Which university are you applying to? B: I am applying to the University of Natural Sciences. The entrance exam is in July, so I need to study hard now.
questions.explain: Câu 1: Mai muốn học khoa học môi trường ('environmental science'). Câu 2: kỳ thi đầu vào vào tháng 7.
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

sub_questions.q: What does Mai want to study at university?
When is the entrance exam?

questions.audio_text: Good morning, everyone. As the head of the English club, I would like to announce our plan for this semester. We will organise a speaking contest on the last Friday of this month. The topic is 'My Dream Job'. Each participant will have five minutes to present. The winner will receive a set of English books and a certificate. Please register with me before Wednesday.
questions.explain: Câu 1: chủ đề là 'My Dream Job' (công việc mơ ước). Câu 2: đăng ký trước thứ Tư.
questions.q: Nghe thông báo và trả lời câu hỏi

sub_questions.q: What is the topic of the speaking contest?
When should students register?

questions.audio_text: A: I heard you got a part-time job, Tuan. Congratulations! B: Thanks! I work as a waiter at a coffee shop near my house. A: How many hours do you work each week? B: About fifteen hours, mostly in the evenings and at weekends. A: Does it affect your studies? B: Not really. I have learned to manage my time better, and the extra money helps my family.
questions.explain: Câu 1: Tuấn làm bồi bàn ở quán cà phê ('as a waiter at a coffee shop'). Câu 2: làm khoảng 15 giờ/tuần.
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

sub_questions.q: What is Tuan's part-time job?
How many hours does Tuan work each week?

questions.audio_text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the City Museum. Before we begin the tour, please note a few rules. Photography is allowed, but please do not use flash. Please do not touch the exhibits. The tour will last about ninety minutes, and we will visit three main galleries: ancient history, modern art, and natural science. If you have any questions, please feel free to ask me.
questions.explain: Câu 1: được chụp ảnh nhưng không dùng đèn flash ('do not use flash'). Câu 2: chuyến tham quan kéo dài khoảng 90 phút.
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hướng dẫn và trả lời câu hỏi

options: B. Flash photography is not allowed
sub_questions.q: What is one rule of the museum?
How long will the tour last?

questions.audio_text: A: Why were you absent from class yesterday, Hoa? B: I had a bad cold and a high fever, so my mother took me to the hospital. A: Are you feeling better now? B: Yes, much better. The doctor gave me some medicine and told me to rest for two days. A: Take care! I will lend you my notes so you can catch up with the lessons.
questions.explain: Câu 1: Hoa bị cảm lạnh nặng và sốt cao ('a bad cold and a high fever'). Câu 2: bạn sẽ cho mượn vở ghi chép ('lend you my notes').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

options: A. She had a bad cold and a high fever
sub_questions.q: Why was Hoa absent from class yesterday?

options: B. Take her to the hospital
D. Lend her the class notes
sub_questions.q: What will the speaker do to help Hoa?

questions.audio_text: In recent years, many young people in Vietnam have started their own businesses. One inspiring example is Nguyen Van An, a 25-year-old from Hanoi. After graduating from university, he could not find a suitable job, so he decided to open an online shop selling handmade soaps. At first, he had only ten customers, but thanks to social media, his business has grown quickly. Now he employs fifteen workers and exports his products to three countries.
questions.explain: Câu 1: An mở cửa hàng online bán xà phòng thủ công ('selling handmade soaps'). Câu 2: hiện tại An có 15 nhân viên ('employs fifteen workers').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn văn và trả lời câu hỏi

sub_questions.q: What does Nguyen Van An sell?
How many workers does An employ now?

questions.audio_text: A: Mom, our class is organising a charity trip to a mountainous village next month. B: That sounds meaningful! What will you do there? A: We will teach English to the local children, repair their school library, and give them warm clothes for winter. B: How can I help? A: You can donate some old clothes or books. Every small contribution counts!
questions.explain: Câu 1: lớp tổ chức chuyến từ thiện đến làng vùng núi ('charity trip to a mountainous village'). Câu 2: sẽ dạy tiếng Anh, sửa thư viện và tặng quần áo ấm.
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

sub_questions.q: Where is the class going for the charity trip?

options: D. Teach English and repair the library
sub_questions.q: What will the students do there?

questions.audio_text: Good evening. Here is the weather forecast for tomorrow. In the north, it will be cold and rainy, with temperatures between 12 and 16 degrees. In the central region, there will be heavy rain and strong winds, so people should be careful when going out. In the south, it will be sunny and hot, with temperatures up to 34 degrees. That is the end of the weather forecast. Thank you for listening.
questions.explain: Câu 1: miền Bắc lạnh và mưa, 12-16 độ. Câu 2: miền Trung mưa to và gió mạnh.
questions.q: Nghe bản tin thời tiết và trả lời câu hỏi

sub_questions.q: What will the weather be like in the north tomorrow?

options: B. It will be cool and dry
C. There will be heavy rain and strong winds
D. Temperatures will drop to 10 degrees
sub_questions.q: What is the forecast for the central region?
